work.author: Cantus Index
work.description: An online catalogue assigning a stable identifier to each chant text and gathering the databases that carry it. Each record page prints the chant's text and its usual feast; the concordance tables that carry the manuscript witnesses load by a later request and are not part of a record page's own bytes.
work.title: Cantus Index, the catalogue of chant texts and melodies
